The most recent changes will always appear at the top.

== October 2026 ==

----

<div class="mw-collapsible">
'''October 2026 Week 3'''
<div class="mw-collapsible-content">
* [[Haunted Creek|Halloween event]] rerun
** Returning: 6 [[Equipment#Limited-Time_Equipment|Equipment]], [[Pumpkin Pan|Pan]]/[[Pumpkin Shovel|Shovel]], {{Haunted Creek}}
** New [[Trinkets|Trinket]]
** New [[Halloween_Forge#Dullahan's_Curse|Equipment]]
* Inventory is split into categories for easier sorting, can be disabled in [[Settings Menu|settings]]
* Some early game / tutorial changes
* Bug fixes
</div></div>

----

<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed">
'''October 2026 Week 1'''
<div class="mw-collapsible-content">
* New ([[Aetherium]]) [[Enchanting#tabber-Shovels|Shovel Enchants]]: {{Enchant|Overdrive}}, {{Enchant|Tempered}}, {{Enchant|Crystalline}}
* Common shovel enchants cannot be obtained when rolling with Aetherium
* {{Enchant|Void Touched}} and {{Enchant|Mastered}} enchants require Aetherium to roll
* Removed the modifier requirement from [[Aetherite]] for shovel enchanting
* [[Crafting_Anvil|Crafting Recommendations]]: Certain equipment are recommended in the crafting menu based on your progression/build (can be disabled in [[Settings_Menu|settings]])
* If you are able to craft an item, it is highlighted in the crafting menu
* [[Pharaoh's_Pan|Pharaoh Set]] Passive: Gain up to +2x Luck and +100% dig/shake speed by gaining energy in the sun/{{Luminant Totem}}s; also get up to +0.4x capacity at max charge, starting from 50% charge
* [[Dredge Master]] [[Waypoints#tabber-Dredge_Master|waypoint]]
* Onboarding improvements
* [[Museum]] stat boosts at lowest weight increased (stat boost at highest weight is still the same)
* Challenge/progression [[Quests|quests]] are also different colors in the quest menu
* Certain quests give [[Potions|potions]] as rewards
* Drinking a potion has an animation
* Potion stats are displayed in the tooltip
* Other miscellaneous UI improvements
* {{Abyssal Depth}} maze gate removed
</div></div>

== September 2026 ==

----

<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed">
'''September 2026 Week 3'''
<div class="mw-collapsible-content">
* Onboarding improvements
* [[Events#tabber-The_Void|The Void]] added to the natural event pool; [[Events#tabber-Mythic_Rift|Mythic Rift]] removed from natural event pool
* [[MVP#tabber-Event_Planner|Event Planner]] grants 5% increased friend luck
* [[Treasure Map]] minimum level to find raised to 15
* [[Quests#tabber-Volcanic_Sands|Icebreaker]] quest has more detailed waypoints
* Added a small UI bounce effect when shaking/panning
* Some early game [[Equipment|equipment]] buffed
* Some early-mid game [[Pans|pans]] buffed
* Collection now displays the best location for ores that the player is capable of digging in
* Vote booths do not show up in new players' servers (haven't completed Rubble Creek 2)
* [[MVP#Voting|"Momentum" system to voting]]: When an MVP wins, they lose 20% vote weight in future votes, stacking up to 80%. If they lose a vote, they gain 20% lost vote weight back
* Potentially fixed some issues with auto pan
</div></div>

** 🪣 New stat type: '''[[Stats|Inventory Size]]''' added to select equipment (auto-granted at 100% for existing items when equipped)
** 🍶 '''Potion Seller''' added at [[Snowy Mountain]]
** 🏷️ Small price tags now appear above purchasable items
</div></div>

== September 2025 – Excavations and Overgrown Grotto ==
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed">
'''⛏️ September 2025 – Excavations & Events Update'''
<div class="mw-collapsible-content">
* ⛏️ '''[[Excavations]]:''' Excavations can be started at excavation sites to earn relics and geodes after a period of time, sites are around {{Volcano}} and [[Snowy Mountain]]
* Excavations can be leveled up the more you do them
* New relics added for excavations, more will be added in the future
* 🌟 Two new events: [[Events|Nimue's Blessing]] and [[Events|Geode Shower]]
* ⏱️ Events now occur every 30 minutes instead of every hour due to the increased number of events
* 📍 Quests now have location markers for certain steps
* 💬 Dialog can be skipped by clicking again
* 🏛️ The weight required for maximum [[Museum]] stats has been significantly increased, boost from exotic ores reduced
* 🔒 Setting: Auto lock new discoveries — auto locks ores that:
** have not been discovered
** have a new modifier
** break your weight record for that ore
* 💎 Geodes can now be picked up by simply walking on them
* 🎒 Some optimizations for backpack
* 🌿 Vineheart rate increased
</div></div>
